name: Wish-First Experience Composer MVP
summary: Replaces the system-led timeline planner with a wish-first Experience Composer that lets visitors choose what they want to do and receive three realistic day proposals.
changes: Introduces a wish-first selection experience built from the domain content package
Generates three different day proposals from the same selected building blocks
Adds group context, dining rhythm and pace without forcing fixed time slots
Supports later Spanish dining and earlier family-oriented dining
Uses opening windows, estimated duration and transport in composition
Adds inspiration mode for visitors who do not know what to choose
Adds copy, email and download actions for the resulting plan
Records anonymous selection and generation signals for future aggregate learning
Keeps the generic engine independent from Casa Amar content
manual_review: Confirm v2026.07.24.250 appears on desktop and mobile
Build a day around Ronda and confirm the anchor remains stable
Replace an evening block and confirm Ronda is retained
Replace a restaurant and confirm only the selected block changes
Check real start/end times and displayed transport estimates
Lock a block and change pace or interest
Use undo and copy the resulting plan
title: Wish-First Experience Composer MVP
test: Kontrollér, at BETA-badget viser v2026.07.24.250 på computer og mobil.
Vælg Mijas Pueblo, strand, pool og Primavera, og generér en plan.
Skift mellem de tre planforslag, og kontrollér, at rækkefølgen ændrer sig.
Vælg Sen spansk middag, og kontrollér, at middag placeres sent.
Vælg Tidligere middag, og kontrollér, at middag placeres tidligere.
Vælg Familie med baby og Roligt tempo, og generér en plan.
Fjern og tilføj ønsker, og kontrollér, at planen først opdateres, når den genereres igen.
Tryk Inspirér mig, og kontrollér, at der vælges en relevant kombination.
Test Kopiér, Send med mail og Download.
Kontrollér, at galleri, forespørgselsflow og Mission Control fortsat fungerer.
